summary: (standards pass) preflight_errors accepts an unguarded `npm whoami` when a guarded one also exists: whoami_guarded turns True as soon as ANY call sits under `if [ -n "$ABSENT" ]; then`, and a call not at the start of a line (`WHO=$(npm whoami)`) is not counted at all. Probe on a copy of publish.yml at 24b8194a6: adding `npm whoami` (or `WHO=$(npm whoami)`) before the ABSENT block leaves check-release-workflow-safety.py at exit 0. That is the I11 case 'the pre-flight npm whoami runs without the package-absence condition', and the failure it exists to stop (an expired NPM_TOKEN blocking every release after trusted publishing takes over) would ship unnoticed. Fix: fail on every `npm whoami` in a source line of the step that is not inside the ABSENT then-branch, and add a test with one guarded and one unguarded call. Blast radius: the shipped publish.yml is correct today; only a later edit is unprotected.
